## Objective
- Build a complete playable 3D gore-themed combat sandbox with selectable NPCs, combat interactions, weapons, and arena maps featuring an island mansion and pool.

## Requirements
- Sandbox spawn menu for frontier/Native-style dark-skinned NPCs with random-color bandanas, police with a 50/50 handgun or shotgun, civilians, and zombies.
- Attack, pickup, and grab controls; grabbed NPCs ragdoll. NPCs should be breakable, with head/torso damage effects and fall damage.
- Add guns and melee weapons, plus arena maps where player spawning is disabled and enemies are zombies.
- Island map should have a mansion and a backyard pool.
- User requested a playable game now, with reasonable assumptions and no clarification questions.

## Decisions
- Implemented in-browser using Three.js from an import map, with procedural geometry and no project dependencies.
- NPC spawn cap is 14; excess NPCs are not spawned. Arena mode automatically spawns zombies and replenishes groups.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with responsive HUD, intro screen, spawn-selection menu, mode/map selectors, and touch controls.
- Created `game.js` implementing Three.js scenes/maps, player controls, weapons/pickups, NPC types, zombie arena waves, combat, ragdoll/death effects, and responsive resize.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Browser opened at `http://localhost:3002`; screenshot saved to `screenshots/deadwater.jpg`.

### Blocked

2. Correct geometry dimension expressions and reload the browser; ensure no JS/Three errors.

4. Check `git status` and report final verification; changes remain uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell, HUD, menus, styling, and Three.js import map.
- `game.js`: Game logic and procedural 3D scene.
- `screenshots/deadwater.jpg`: Current captured intro-screen screenshot.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D combat sandbox with selectable NPCs, weapons, combat interactions, and arena maps, including an island mansion with a backyard pool.

## Requirements
- Spawn-menu choices: frontier/Native-style dark-skinned NPCs with random-color bandanas, police with a 50/50 handgun or shotgun, civilians, and zombies.
- Attack, pickup, and grab controls; grabbed NPCs ragdoll. NPCs can be damaged, with head/torso effects and fall damage.
- Include guns and melee weapons, plus arena maps where spawning is disabled and enemies are zombies.
- Support desktop and mobile controls; make reasonable assumptions and don’t ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a browser game with Three.js, procedural geometry, and no project dependencies.
- NPC spawn cap is 14; arena mode spawns zombie waves.

### Completed
- Created `index.html` with intro, HUD, spawn menu, map/mode selectors, and touch controls.

- Build a complete, playable 3D combat sandbox with selectable NPCs, weapons, combat interactions, and arena maps, including an island mansion with a backyard pool.

- Spawn-menu choices: frontier/Native-style dark-skinned NPCs with random-color bandanas, police with a 50/50 handgun or shotgun, civilians, and zombies.

- Support desktop and mobile controls; make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D combat sandbox with selectable NPCs, weapons, combat interactions, and arena maps, including an island mansion with a backyard pool.

## Requirements
- Spawn-menu choices: frontier/Native-style dark-skinned NPCs with random-color bandanas, police with a 50/50 handgun or shotgun, civilians, and zombies.
- Attack, pickup, and grab controls; grabbed NPCs ragdoll. NPCs can be damaged, with head/torso effects and fall damage.
- Include guns and melee weapons, plus arena maps where spawning is disabled and enemies are zombies.
- Support desktop and mobile controls; make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a browser game with Three.js, procedural geometry, and no project dependencies.
- NPC spawn cap is 14; arena mode spawns zombie waves.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with intro, HUD, spawn menu, map/mode selectors, and touch controls.

3. Refresh/inspect the gameplay screenshot and check `git status`.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D combat sandbox with selectable NPCs, weapons, combat interactions, and arena maps, including an island mansion with a backyard pool.

## Requirements
- Spawn-menu choices: frontier/Native-style dark-skinned NPCs with random-color bandanas, police with a 50/50 handgun or shotgun, civilians, and zombies.
- Attack, pickup, and grab controls; grabbed NPCs ragdoll. NPCs can be damaged, with head/torso effects and fall damage.
- Include guns and melee weapons, plus arena maps where spawning is disabled and enemies are zombies.
- Support desktop and mobile controls; make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a browser game with Three.js, procedural geometry, and no project dependencies.
- NPC spawn cap is 14; arena mode spawns zombie waves.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with intro, HUD, spawn menu, map/mode selectors, and touch controls.
- Created `game.js` with procedural scenes, NPCs, weapons, combat, ragdoll/death effects, zombie waves, and resize handling.
- Fixed invalid `BoxGeometry` dimensions in mansion window trim; browser reload reports no console errors.
- Verified gameplay entry, NPC spawning, weapon cycling, map switching, arena mode disabling spawning, and mobile controls at 390×844 without overflow.
- Raised `#hud` stacking order and improved mobile layout to separate HUD from movement/action controls.
- Fixed click behavior so clicking the game canvas while pointer-locked attacks; updated control hint to include `Space`, `Esc`, and `G`.
- Browser checks after the latest reload reported no console errors.

### Active
- Continue testing combat interactions, map changes, arena zombie waves, and mobile touch behavior.

### Blocked
- Normal browser automation clicks on HUD controls are intercepted by the canvas while pointer lock is active; use keyboard controls, release pointer lock, or DOM-triggered clicks for tests.

## Next Move
1. Retest HUD spawn button with pointer lock released and verify it toggles the menu.
2. Test NPC types, attack/grab/pickup, combat damage and ragdoll, map changes, arena waves, and touch controls.
3. Refresh/inspect the gameplay screenshot and check `git status`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell, HUD, menus, styling, and Three.js import map.
- `game.js`: Game logic, procedural scenes, controls, NPCs, and combat.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files appear as untracked: `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`.
- Server is available at `http://localhost:3002`; browser session was left at mobile viewport after gameplay checks.
- Latest mobile layout positions health and weapon HUD above the movement pad, puts spawn/pickup/weapon actions at upper right, and places attack/grab controls in the lower right.
- Latest screenshot was captured using `playwright-cli -s=default screenshot`; prior screenshot paths are under `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/output/`.
